rules: Always create a separate function to render HTML files — do NOT render directly from API functions.
APIs should return JSON responses only. Use separate view functions for HTML rendering.
Do NOT write or repeat basic template code like generic 'hello world' or route setups.
Do NOT summarize or skip code logic. Always be precise and detailed.
Always check if the code already exists before writing anything new. No duplication.
Do NOT overwrite or rewrite existing code unless explicitly instructed.
Avoid general-purpose code. Every piece of code should be specific to the current project structure and use case.
Use exact folder structure and respect the design pattern established in previous files.
Never write placeholder comments like 'to be implemented' or 'to be added'. Always provide complete production ready implementations.
Always for templates use inline html css for screens like for 1 screen i want 1 html file that have css and js for that screen except global files
Always use tailwind css for styling
Always use CMD for run the commands for any task
Always use MCP tool to see the database and always see the database related tables, columns or data if table have any data when you make APIS
Always use the latest version of the code and always use the latest version of the code when you make any changes

subtask: Initialize FastAPI project with recommended folder structure (/app/routes, /models, /templates, /static, /schemas). Configure PostgreSQL connection using SQLAlchemy. Create .env for secret keys and DB credentials. Create a virtual environment with python3.13 ('C:\Users\dell\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python313\python.exe') and than start working

BUILD AUTHENTICATION APIS: POST /api/auth/register - accepts {role, full_name, email, phone, password, terms_accepted}, returns {user_id, verification_required}. POST /api/auth/verify-otp - accepts {user_id, otp_code, verification_type}, returns {access_token, refresh_token, user_profile}. POST /api/auth/login - accepts {email_or_phone, password}, supports both email/phone login, returns {access_token, refresh_token, user_profile, role}. POST /api/auth/login-otp - sends OTP to phone/email, accepts {contact}, returns {otp_sent, expires_in}. POST /api/auth/social-login - accepts {provider, token}, supports Google/Apple OAuth. POST /api/auth/logout - invalidates current session. GET /api/auth/me - returns current user profile with role permissions. POST /api/auth/refresh-token - accepts refresh token, returns new access token. POST /api/auth/forgot-password - sends reset link/OTP. POST /api/auth/reset-password - accepts {reset_token, new_password}.
